caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate candlestick positioned upright and centered on a plain background. The candlestick has a circular, flat top for holding a candle, supported by a short cylindrical section which transitions into a bulbous, rounded feature. Below this, the central shaft is straight and cylindrical, connecting to a bell-shaped lower section with decorative vertical ridges. The base of the candlestick is broad, with stepped, tiered concentric layers and rests on four short feet at each corner. The object is rendered in grayscale with subtle shading to indicate depth and the reflective quality of the surface, while the background is an off-white color with scattered, light brown stains or marks. The artist's signature, "JOSEPHA RITERV," is faintly written in small letters near the bottom right of the candlestick.
title: Candlestick
